character.name: Idle
character.prompt: An enemy creature grown from a tangle of wire clothes hangers, for a 1990s American shopping mall horror roguelite. Dozens of steel wire hangers are twisted together into a hunched spider-like body: the hooks splay outward as legs, a dense nest of wires forms the torso, and one larger hook rises where a head would be, bent forward like a beak. Snagged in the wires are fragments of 1990s clothing - a torn sleeve, a shirt collar, and a blank price-tag shape containing NO lettering. The metal is dull chrome with rust at the joints and the fabric scraps are faded and greyed. CRITICAL: it must still read at a glance as clothes hangers. STYLE: detailed late-SNES pixel art, crisp hard pixels, clean deliberate clusters, selective outlines, minimal dithering, no anti-aliasing, no blur. LIGHTING: neutral overhead fluorescent mall lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
